raw.description:
Organizations have never had more ways to reach people. More channels. More content. More data. More expertise. Yet influence remains scarce.

People decide what to trust. What to believe. What to adopt. What to join. What to ignore. The gap between what organizations intend and what people do is where growth is won or lost.

That's where strategy matters. We're looking for a Creative & Brand Strategist to help organizations navigate that gap. This is a senior leadership role for a strategist who can transform complexity into clarity, insight into direction, and direction into ideas that create measurable impact.

You'll work across brand, marketing, customer experience, communications, digital transformation, and organizational challenges - helping clients identify opportunities, define strategic choices, and create meaningful connections with the people they serve.

The Opportunity

As a Creative & Brand Strategist, you will lead strategic development across integrated engagements that span brand, campaign, digital experience, customer engagement, and organizational transformation.

You will partner with researchers, behavioral scientists, consultants, creatives, technologists, and client leaders to uncover what drives decisions and define what should happen next.

You'll be responsible for shaping the strategic foundation behind the work: identifying opportunities, framing challenges, developing positioning, creating narratives, and inspiring ideas that move people to action.

This role requires equal comfort in the boardroom, workshop, research review, and creative briefing. You will influence executive stakeholders, guide multidisciplinary teams, and ensure strategy serves as a catalyst for both creativity and business outcomes.

What You'll Do

  • Lead strategic direction across brands, campaigns, experiences, and integrated initiatives.
  • Translate research, data, and audience understanding into actionable insights and strategic recommendations.
  • Develop brand positioning, value propositions, messaging frameworks, narrative platforms, and campaign strategies.
  • Partner with research, analytics and account teams to unlock audience drivers, develop personas and segmentation strategies that drive program development and delivery.
  • Contribute to developing key performance indicators and program evaluation approaches.
  • Create clear, inspiring briefs that drive exceptional creative and experience design work.
  • Facilitate stakeholder workshops, executive alignment sessions, and strategic planning engagements.
  • Identify emerging cultural, behavioral, and market shifts that create new opportunities for clients.
  • Partner closely with research, customer experience, creative, digital, consulting, and account teams to solve complex business challenges.
  • Check for strategy and brand consistency in creative concepting and delivery.

What We're Looking For

You are a strategist first. You know how to uncover meaningful insights, define compelling positions, build persuasive narratives, and create strategic direction that inspires action. You understand that brands are not simply communications systems - they are systems of meaning.

You see audiences as people, not segments. You know how to connect human motivations with organizational goals. You can move comfortably between long-term brand building and immediate business priorities. Between analytical rigor and creative imagination. Between evidence, intuition, and judgment. Most importantly, you know that strategy is not about having all the answers. It's about asking the questions that reveal opportunities others miss.

You Bring:

Professional Skills

  • Significant experience in brand strategy, communications planning, creative strategy, customer strategy, consumer behavioral psychology, consulting, or a related discipline.
  • A strong track record of leading strategic work across complex, multidisciplinary engagements and with cross-functional marketing teams.
  • Experience developing positioning, messaging architectures, audience personas, narrative frameworks, campaign strategies, and creative briefs.
  • Strong facilitation and stakeholder management skills, including executive-level engagement.
  • Exceptional communication, storytelling, and presentation abilities.
  • Proven ability to align diverse stakeholders around strategic direction and organizational priorities
  • Curiosity about culture, behavior, technology, and the forces shaping how people make decisions
  • Experience using AI as a tool to make our research and deliverables smarter and more efficient.
  • Primary and secondary research experience and demonstrated ability to use the data to unlock insights that drive program design.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, market research, journalism, sociology or related fields. (applicants can substitute one year of related experience for one year of education)
  • 10+ years of experience developing and leading brand, communications, customer experience, or business strategies within agencies, consultancies, or client organizations.
  • Must be able to pass a background check and secure public trust clearance.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role is not measured by the number of strategies created. It's measured by the decisions those strategies enable.

You will:

  • Help clients see opportunities they couldn't previously see.
  • Bring clarity to ambiguity and alignment to complexity.
  • Influence critical business, brand, and experience decisions.
  • Elevate the quality of creative thinking across teams.
  • Strengthen client relationships through trusted strategic leadership.
  • Create work that earns attention, builds trust, drives participation, and delivers meaningful outcomes.
  • Build a stronger culture of strategic thinking across teams, improving how opportunities are identified, framed, and brought to market.

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer.Together, our employees are empowered to share theirexpertiseand collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. For more information, please read our EEOpolicy.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Reasonable Accommodations are available, including, but not limited to, for disabled veterans, individuals with disabilities, and individuals withsincerely heldreligious beliefs, in all phases of the application and employment process. To requestan accommodation,please email Candidateaccommodation@icf.com and we will be happy toassist. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extentrequiredto provide needed reasonable accommodations. 

Read more about workplace discrimination rightsor our benefit offerings which are included in the Transparency in (Benefits) CoverageAct.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

At ICF, we are committed to ensuring a fair interview process for all candidates based on their own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to generate orassistwith responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is notpermitted. This policy is in place tomaintainthe integrity and authenticity of the interview process. 

However, we understand that some candidates may require accommodation that involves the use of AI. Ifsuch anaccommodation is needed, candidates are instructed to contact us in advance at candidateaccommodation@icf.com. Weare dedicated to providingthe necessary support to ensure that all candidates have an equal opportunity to succeed.

This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for technical professionals with hands-on experience in web scraping, data extraction and processing.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Python Data Scraping Engineer, you'll handle data scraping tasks requiring technical precision for web extraction and processing, utilizing various tools such as our provided Apify and OpenRouter alongside your own resourceful approaches.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end data extraction workflows across complex websites, ensuring complete coverage, accuracy, and reliable delivery of structured datasets.

  • Enforce data quality standards through validation checks, cross-source consistency controls, adherence to formatting specifications, and systematic verification prior to delivery.
  • Scale scraping operations for large datasets using efficient batching or parallelization, monitor failures, and maintain stability against minor site structure changes.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $25 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

How to get started

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects that match your technical skills, on your own schedule. From coding and automation to fine-tuning AI outputs, you’ll play a key role in advancing AI capabilities and real-world applications.

Requirements

  • At least 3 year of relevant experience in data engineering, web scraping, automation, or software development (required).

  • Strong experience in Python web scraping (BeautifulSoup, Selenium or similar), including dynamic content (JS, AJAX, infinite scroll) and APIs via proxies.

Benefits

  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Gain hands-on experience in a unique hybrid environment where human expertise and AI agents collaborate seamlessly — a distinctive skill set in a rapidly growing field.
  • Participate in performance-based bonus programs that reward high-quality work and consistent delivery.

Mandatory Notices

U.S. Export Controls Disclaimer: In accordance with the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR §743.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status.

We’re Dealer Tire, a family-owned, international distributor of tires and parts established in 1918 in Cleveland, OH. Compensation Strategy & Market Analysis

  • Manage incentive and bonus plan communication and administration for all non-exempt roles.
  • Partner with the Senior Compensation Specialist on the administration of the annual merit process.
  • Partner with the business to annually update all incentive programs including sales commission plans, departmental plans and Profit Sharing plans.

Workday Administration & Business Partnership

  • Maintain compensation data and ensure accuracy in Workday, including compensation grades, compensation grade profiles, compensation plans, and assignments.
  • Review all offers of employment within Workday and ensure accuracy and compliance.
  • Process wage and salary adjustments in Workday due to merit increases, market adjustments, promotions or other job changes.

HR Executive

Ready to build your HR career in a fast-moving, global business where operations, accuracy, and employee experience really matter? Apply now and join our growing HR team at Support Revolution!

About the role:

We’re looking for a highly organised, detail-driven HR Executive who thrives on structure, process and making things run seamlessly behind the scenes.

This is a key operational role supporting the full employee lifecycle across onboarding, offboarding, HR systems and day-to-day HR administration. You’ll be the backbone of our HR function, ensuring data is accurate, processes are followed, and employees receive a smooth, professional experience at every stage.

Working closely with the COO and HR Manager, you’ll gain exposure across our global HR operations, compliance, HRIS, and cross-functional collaboration with IT, Finance, and Operations.

If you’re detail-focused and thrive when juggling competing priorities, this is a fantastic opportunity to develop your HR career in a dynamic business. Apply today and join us!

What you’ll be doing:

As HR Executive, no two days will be the same. You can expect to be involved with:

  • Managing day-to-day HR administration and employee queries via the shared HR inbox
  • Coordinating onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring a smooth and compliant employee journey
  • Preparing, issuing and tracking HR documentation including contracts, letters, and policy updates
  • Maintaining accurate employee records across HR systems, ensuring data integrity at all times
  • Liaising with IT, Finance, Operations and managers to support end-to-end HR processes
  • Supporting benefits administration, absence tracking and employee lifecycle changes
  • Assisting with HR reporting, audits and compliance activities, including ISO-aligned documentation
  • Supporting HR meetings, note-taking and tracking of actions and follow-ups
  • Identifying process gaps and supporting continuous improvement across HR operations.

What we’re looking for:

This role is perfect for someone who has:

  • 2+ years' experience in HR administration, HR coordination or people operations support
  • Strong understanding of HR processes and UK employment fundamentals
  • High attention to detail with a strong focus on accuracy and consistency
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience working with HR systems (HRIS) and maintaining employee data
  • Comfortable handling confidential and sensitive information with discretion
  • Proactive, organised, and solution-focused approach
  • A genuine interest in HR operations, systems, and improving how things work.

Interview process:

Our hiring process is designed to be efficient and transparent. Here’s what to expect:

  1. Screening Call – A friendly chat with our Talent Acquisition team to get to know you and discuss the role
  2. Hiring Manager Interview – Your chance to showcase your skills, experience, and ask us any questions about the role and team
  3. Team Interview – Get to meet with other team members, dive into the exciting projects you’ll be working on, and experience the collaborative energy that drives our success!
  4. Final HR Interview – A deeper conversation to understand your values, ensure a great cultural fit, and discuss the next steps.

Benefits and perks:

  • Competitive Salary: We value your hard work with a competitive salary

  • Length of Service Rewards: Enjoy rewards like bonuses, extra leave, and paid sabbaticals for your dedication
  • Company Pension Scheme: Secure your future with our Company pension scheme
  • Perkbox Perks: Treat yourself with discounts, cashback, and wellness benefits
  • Fully Remote Model: Enjoy the flexibility of working 100% remotely, from wherever you are in the UK - no office required!
  • Employee Wellbeing: We’ve got your back with EAP, eye tests, flu vouchers, and excellent sick pay if you’re ever unwell
  • Personal Development: We invest in you with tailored training and career growth
  • Employee Referral Scheme: Get rewarded for bringing great talent to our team.

À propos de Dialogue

Dialogue est le principal fournisseur de soins virtuels au Canada. En perfectionnant notre Plateforme de santé intégrée, nous offrons des programmes exceptionnels de santé et de bien-être en ligne (soins primaires, santé mentale, TCCi, PAE et bien-être) aux organisations qui souhaitent améliorer le bien-être de leurs employé(e)s et de leurs familles.

Lorsqu'il s'agit de notre travail, nous plaçons la barre très haut. Ensemble, nous transformons la santé et aidons des millions de personnes à améliorer leur bien-être. Nous croyons fermement qu’une équipe exceptionnelle exige plus pour sa :

  • Réussite
  • Communauté
  • Croissance
  • Performance

Vous avez l’impression de pouvoir changer les choses? Bonne nouvelle, nous avons une place pour vous!

Nous vous acceptons comme vous êtes. En tant qu’employeur soucieux de l’égalité des chances, Dialogue s’engage à créer un lieu de travail diversifié et inclusif pour tout le monde. Les personnes qualifiées qui poseront leur candidature seront considérées sans égard à la citoyenneté, l’origine ethnique, la race, la couleur, la religion, le sexe, l’identité ou l’expression sexuelle, l’orientation sexuelle, le handicap, l’âge ou le statut de vétéran. Les personnes qui ont besoin d’accommodations spéciaux sont invitées à nous écrire à l’adresse accessibilite@dialogue.co

Déclaration sur l'utilisation de l'IA

Afin d'assurer un processus d'examen efficace et équitable, nous utilisons des outils d'intelligence artificielle pour aider au tri et à l'évaluation initiale des candidatures pour ce poste.

⚠️ Avis de fraude en recrutement

Dialogue communique avec les candidat(e)s uniquement par des adresses courriel officielles @dialogue.co. Nous ne demandons jamais de paiement, de cartes-cadeaux ni de renseignements financiers personnels à quelque étape que ce soit du processus d'embauche, et nous n'envoyons jamais d'offre d'emploi sans un processus d'entrevue structuré. Tous nos postes sont affichés exclusivement sur dialogue.co/fr/carrieres. Si vous recevez une communication suspecte prétendant provenir de Dialogue, ne répondez pas — signalez-la à jobs@dialogue.co et vérifiez le poste sur notre page carrières officielle.

Votre rôle à titre de Médecin, soirs et fins de semaine

La mission du médecin est d'assurer l'évaluation, les soins et l'orientation des patients qui consultent virtuellement en collaborant avec une équipe multidisciplinaire. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec notre équipe virtuelle afin d'assurer une expérience sans faille tout au long de leur parcours de soins.

Vos responsabilités

  • Effectuer des évaluations à distance via la plateforme Dialogue Care, où vous évaluerez les symptômes, diagnostiquerez et fournirez un traitement pour des conditions communes et complexes.
  • Fournir des soins de haute qualité aux patients en offrant des conseils médicaux opportuns et en identifiant les symptômes urgents.
  • Créer des plans de soins personnalisés adaptés aux besoins de vos patients
  • Collaborer avec une équipe interdisciplinaire de médecins, d'infirmières, de coordinateurs et de gestionnaires de soins, de psychologues, etc. afin de fournir des soins complets et de haute qualité
  • Éduquer et soutenir les patients en matière de soins préventifs, de gestion de la santé et de changement de mode de vie
  • Orienter les patients, le cas échéant, vers des spécialistes ou des professionnels paramédicaux et des services communautaires.
  • Tenir des dossiers détaillés sur les interactions avec les patients, les plans de traitement et les suivis, dans le respect des normes réglementaires
  • Contribuer à des projets ou initiatives internes

Nous aimerions beaucoup vous rencontrer si vous possédez

  • Un minimum de deux ans d’expérience en tant que médecin
  • Une aisance à consulter en français et/ou en anglais
  • De la disponibilité pour travailler au moins 8 heures par semaine, les soirs et les fins de semaine
  • Un permis de pratique médicale valide et actif au Québec
  • Une assurance responsabilité professionnelle appropriée
  • Une bonne aisance avec la technologie et les outils numériques
  • De l’autonomie, du professionnalisme, de la capacité d’adaptation et de la rigueur

Ce que nous pouvons vous offrir:

  • Un rôle entièrement virtuel et à distance — travaillez dans le confort de votre foyer, sans obligation de vous déplacer dans un lieu physique

Job Description

Senior Architect (Integration - Germany), Professional Services

Native German language skills are required

Guidewire is seeking highly motivated integration experts who are looking to work with current, leading-edge technology on challenging, customer-focused consulting and implementation projects.

This position requires a unique blend of functional and technical aptitude, business savvy, and professional consulting skills. You will become a subject matter expert in insurance industry technical solutions.

The Guidewire Professional Services organization includes business architects, functional consultants, and technical integration consultants who work together to help customers and systems integrators (SI) implement Guidewire software. Our projects are complex and can last from three months to two years depending on the specific customer requirements. During a project, the team will identify customer business requirements, identify solutions leveraging out-of-the-box (OOTB) capabilities coupled with configuration to meet those requirements, and integrate the Guidewire application to other internal and external systems.

Guidewire consultants are expected to spend up to 50% of their time on-site with the customer business and technical teams. This role is focused on the EMEA region with a priority for Germany, Austria and Switzerland, but there may be an opportunity to work in other regions that Guidewire operates in.

What You'll Do

  • You will be responsible for the integration portion of the implementation of Guidewire enterprise software following an Agile methodology.

  • Participate in the full project lifecycle from initial requirements gathering and product definition, through implementation and on to post-production.

  • Work with customers and SI partners to implement Guidewire software, mentoring and applying standards and best practices for implementations.

  • Design, create, configure and implement the necessary integration points for the application architecture using Java, Apache Camel and Guidewire’s proprietary Gosu programming language

  • Collaborate with developers, business analysts, quality assurance testers and project leadership to ensure project success

  • Coordinate the implementation of the custom solutions, assist day-to-day maintenance, support and update issues.

  • Design and implement configuration and integration tests including monitoring software incidents and communicating software issues to Guidewire development professionals.

Technical Skills

  • Strong OO design, development and test skills with proven patterns knowledge, exceptional documentation skills, and the ability to communicate your thought process

  • Enterprise software product implementation experience within complex environments

  • Understand the concepts of both relational and NoSQL databases

  • Be prepared to write and review code, providing recommendations to customers and partners

  • Experience in Agile methodology

  • Highly motivated, results-driven and a tenacious problem solver

  • Coaching and mentoring other internal and external team members on tools, best practices and methodology

  • Curiosity based on genuine love of technology and solving tough technical problems

  • Ability to facilitate workshops, present and explain complex solutions and recommended solutions

  • Native German language skills, as well as strong English oral and written skills

  • BS in Computer Science or equivalent industry experience

Nice to have

  • Guidewire InsuranceSuite experience

  • Insurance industry experience, understanding how the insurance business process from a user perspective

  • Java, J2EE, SQL, JSON, XML experience

  • Knowledge of AWS services and cloud deployment practices

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.

We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. About Lyra

Lyra Health is the leading provider of mental health solutions for employers supporting more than 20 million people globally. The company has delivered 13 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 20 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.
Lyra’s Mental Health Coaches are part of our innovative coaching program. We provide training in our evidence-based mental health coaching model and provide clients directly to you via our easy online booking platform. We manage the business operations so you can focus on what you do best: providing high-quality coaching.
An important note: Lyra's clients come from a multitude of different backgrounds and experiences, and have varying needs and abilities. We strive to continue to meet their unique needs by delivering culturally responsive care—an approach that accounts for the impact of cultural backgrounds on each person’s care experience.

You may be a good fit for this contract role if:

    ● You focus on coaching the whole person, rather than focusing on fixing or problem-solving.
    ● You are comfortable coaching clients as they navigate mental and emotional barriers
    ● You are open to helping clients learn and practice coaching principles such as acceptance, mindfulness, and self-compassion
    ● You demonstrate the ability to authentically connect and be present with your clients
    ● You are independent, experienced using technology to connect with clients, and open to learning and using new content.

    ● Engage in ongoing clinical consultation with Lyra’s expert clinical team who will help you ensure clients are in the right form of care

Requests any additional information required to complete the loan application package prior to submission for processing.
  • Generally provides the required three day disclosures along with other pertinent mortgage disclosures to the member electronically however, may be required to provide them in paper form should the member decline to accept them electronically.   • Assists the assigned mortgage loan processor and closer to obtain documentation to ensure a smooth mortgage loan process. Proactively communicates status of loan throughout the loan process.

  • Cross sells other credit union services.

  • Responsible for understanding mortgage department goals as well as Credit Union goals and pro-actively works toward attainment of those goals.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • All employees and business units, as first line of defense, are expected to proactively help identify, assess, manage, and report risks within their domain of work. The Risk team serves as the second line of defense by providing risk oversight and credible challenge whereas the Audit team serves as the third line of defense by providing risk assurance.

• Focus Focus your full attention by carefully listening to and observing client or member.

Verify necessary follow-up actions.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

  • The incumbent must have a minimum of two years prior experience in the mortgage industry preferably as a mortgage loan officer or mortgage loan interviewer in a direct member contact capacity with a financial or mortgage lending institution. Job Description:

Manager, Market Performance

The Manager, Market Performance is responsible for the day-to-day execution of operational workflows that drive value-based care results. The manager influences through others, ensuring that market-specific initiatives—like member outreach, gap closure, and provider scheduling—are executed with precision. This is a hands-on leadership role that requires strong organizational skills and the ability to coach a team toward hitting immediate operational milestones.

Key Responsibilities

  • P&L Analysis: Analyzes market operations execution, member utilization patterns, and Cityblock’s care model to identify areas of opportunity a) to shift member utilization from high-cost low-value interventions to lower-cost preventative measures, and b) to improve operational efficiency.

  • Operational Execution: Oversees the daily "ground game" of market operations, ensuring that workflows (e.g., hospital discharge follow-ups, HEDIS outreach) are completed on time and accurately.

  • Data Monitoring: Tracks team performance against weekly and monthly KPIs; identifies bottlenecks in workflows and works with stakeholders to implement immediate tactical fixes.

  • Stakeholder Coordination: Acts as a bridge between frontline staff and market and central team leadership, ensuring that barriers to care are escalated and resolved quickly and the team adheres to standardized Cityblock operating procedures.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in healthcare operations, clinic management, or a related service-oriented field.

  • 2+ years of experience directly managing people or leading a significant functional workstream.

  • Familiarity with healthcare metrics (e.g., patient engagement rates, appointment keep rates) and how they contribute to broader market success.

  • Proven ability to solve tactical, day-to-day operational challenges and improve team efficiency.

  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to motivate a team and communicate clearly with diverse stakeholders.

  • Fosters a culture of psychological safety and humility within the immediate team, encouraging open feedback and collaboration.

  • Models a "proactive approach" by ensuring all team tasks are completed with high integrity and excellence.

  • May coach direct reports, helping them build the skills necessary for career progression within the organization.

  • Successfully leads the team through operational changes or new project rollouts with a positive, solutions-oriented mindset.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s required or equivalent combination of experience and education

raw.title: Commercial Attorney
raw.excerpt: Company Overview:At Panopto, we are the most customer-centric learning technologycompany in the world.
raw.description:
Company Overview:

At Panopto, we are the most customer-centric learning technologycompany in the world. As the leader in visual and audio-based learning, we empower organizations to share knowledge effortlessly in a capture and post-capture world. We don’t just build software; we obsess over our users’ goals to deliver solutions that truly matter. Our mission is simple: to attract the brightest talent, people like you, to Elevate the Craft and do the most impactful work of your career.

As a Commercial Attorney, you will play a pivotal role in accelerating Panopto’s business growth by designing, reviewing, and scaling our global contract infrastructure. Reporting directly to the Head of Legal, you will serve as a strategic business partner to our Sales, Finance, and Information Security teams. You will take ownership of the contract lifecycle—ranging from rapid-turnaround NDAs to commercial vendor and customer agreements—ensuring we protect company interests while maintaining the operational velocity needed to close transactions quickly.

How You’ll Contribute: In this role, you will have the opportunity to…

  • Accelerate Deal Velocity: Review, redline, and negotiate customer, vendor, and partner agreements, balancing robust risk management with a pragmatic approach to closing business.

  • Optimize Legal Infrastructure: Manage the legal department’s intake queue within Salesforce, establishing clear triage patterns and conducting initial assessments to resolve inquiries efficiently.

  • Drive Process Automation: Utilize and continuously improve contract management and automation software to streamline initial reviews and eliminate manual administrative friction.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Align with Sales, Finance, Executive leadership, and InfoSec to ensure all necessary compliance approvals are smoothly achieved during the transactional lifecycle.

Within 6 Months — Integration and Audit

  • Conduct an audit of the existing legal case queue and contract data to identify the primary bottlenecks slowing down sales cycles.

  • Achieve full autonomy over the intake, initial triage, and standard redlining of standard customer NDAs and vendor agreements.

Within 1 Year — First Measurable Impact on Contract Cycle Times

  • Reduce the contract-to-close latency for standard agreements by implementing structured playbooks and workflow improvements within the contract management system.

  • Successfully transition routine contract reviews away from executive leadership, allowing the broader team to focus on highly strategic initiatives.

Your Legacy — Full Ownership of Commercial Operations

  • Build out a highly automated, self-sustaining commercial contract framework that scales effortlessly alongside Panopto’s global expansion.

Values in Action

  • Customer First, Always: You proactively surface friction points in the customer experience before they are escalated—and propose solutions, not just reports.

  • Thrive Together: You share work-in-progress for early feedback, knowing that challenge improves the outcome. You separate critiques of ideas from critiques of people.

  • Elevate the Craft: You hold the bar high on your own work and invest in developing those around you. You treat every project as an opportunity to learn something new.

  • Act with Ownership: You define success by outcomes, not activity. You flag problems early and bring a proposed path forward, not just the problem.

  • Clarity Over Complexity: You default to the simpler solution. Your written communication—internal or external—is direct, specific, and free of filler.

How We Thrive

"You’ll join a team where we challenge ideas, not people, knowing our success depends on our collective wisdom. We believe in simple elegance and holding ourselves accountable to outcomes, not just activity". The legal team thrives by providing clear, objective, and solution-oriented paths forward rather than just pointing out legal risks. We operate via collaborative review sessions, helping each other navigate complex negotiations without silos.

The Foundation for Success

  • Commercial Acumen: Demonstrated experience reviewing and negotiating commercial legal agreements (such as customer software agreements, vendor contracts, and partner frameworks) within a corporate ecosystem.

  • System Fluency: Experience working within Salesforce and specialized contract management lifecycle (CLM) platforms to track workflows and drive operational clarity.

  • Pragmatic Problem Solving: A sharp focus on details combined with the ability to think quickly, execute deliberate project follow-through, and exercise exceptional commercial judgment.

  • Diplomatic Communication: Strong interpersonal skills that enable you to build solid, collaborative relationships across sales, finance, and external client teams.

What Sets You Apart

  • A proven history of leveraging legal automation tools to materially decrease standard deal cycle times.

  • A formal legal education background (such as a J.D., LL.M., or a Bachelor’s degree paired with robust corporate paralegal credentials) that balances theoretical correctness with practical business execution.

What Success Looks Like

By day 90, you will have assumed complete operational management of the Salesforce legal case queue and completed a diagnostic assessment of contract process friction points, creating a direct path to faster deal execution.

Beyond the Requirements: At this point, we hope you're feeling excited about the job description you’re reading. Even if you don't feel that you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

We're eager to meet people that believe in our mission and can contribute to our team in a variety of ways - not just candidates who check all the boxes.

We want people to feel comfortable expressing their true selves and to come, stay, and do their best work here.

Recruiting Tips: From crafting an impressive resume to presenting your best self during our interviews, we're dedicated to ensuring you feel well-prepared and self-assured as you embark on opportunities at Panopto. Discover some valuableRecruiting Tipsfrom our team.

The standard interview process at Panopto involves several steps, outlined below, to ensure we approach the process thoughtfully and consistently:

Application Review -> Recruiter Call -> Video Interview & Assessment -> Hiring Manager Call -> Interview Loop -> Debrief -> Offer

Our people and culture

Panopto’s mission is to be the leader in visual and audio-based learning in a capture and post-capture world. Our user base is as diverse as the world’s universities and businesses. Panopto’s commitment to fostering a fair, equitable, and inclusive culture empowers each member of our team to express their authentic selves, contribute their distinct perspectives and make a meaningful impact both individually and collectively. This inclusive environment not only encourages creativity and the free exchange of ideas but also harnesses the power of varied viewpoints. As a result, we are better equipped to tackle our most intricate challenges, leveraging the wealth of different experiences and backgrounds within our team. This collaborative spirit empowers us to challenge ideas (not people) recognizing that our shared success relies on collective wisdom. It drives us to continuously improve and innovate, ultimately elevating the quality of our products and services. It’s what sets Panopto apart as a unique and rewarding place to work.

Our purpose

We believe that video can have a transformative effect on learning. So we built a video knowledge management platform that helps businesses and universities improve the way that they train, teach, and share knowledge. Since 2007, we have been a pioneer in video capture software, video management, and inside-video-search technology. Panopto has been adopted by more than 1,600 companies and universities worldwide with over 11 million end users. Today, Panopto’s knowledge management platform is the largest repository of expert learning videos in the world. A proud remote-first company, Panopto is headquartered in Pittsburgh, with offices in London, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Sydney, and has received industry recognition for its innovation, rapid growth, and company culture.

Panopto is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We value and encourage diversity and solicit applications from all qualified individuals which will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected criteria, in accordance with applicable law. Panopto is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities. If you require accommodation for interviewing or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please provide more detail on how we can further support you by reaching out to the Employee Experience department.

Remote, US: Candidates looking for flexible or remote-friendly positions are encouraged to apply. Panopto is proud to be a remote-first company. Employees in this position are eligible to work remotely.

Remote, International: Candidates looking for flexible or remote-friendly positions are encouraged to apply. Panopto is proud to be a remote-first company. Employees in this position are eligible to work remotely. Still, they may make regular trips to the local international office from time to time, where applicable.

Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI):

Panopto may utilize artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in our recruitment and evaluation process. This may include analyzing resumes, assessing skills, and generating insights to help identify qualified candidates.

Please be assured that AI tools are used to support our team, and all final hiring decisions are made by human reviewers. Panopto hiring teams will thoroughly review your application and assessment results. AI is not used to make final decisions regarding your candidacy.

By submitting your application and participating in the recruitment process, you acknowledge and consent to Panopto's use of AI tools as described above.

We are committed to full compliance with all applicable labor laws, including Equal Employment (EEOC) laws, across all our company entities.

To ensure fairness and transparency: We have human oversight in all hiring decisions. If you have concerns regarding the use of AI in your assessment, please contact Panopto Talent Attraction to request a manual review of your application. Please be aware that while we offer this option, the manual review process may take longer than the standard AI-assisted process.

Any data collected during this process, including video recordings if applicable, will be retained only for the duration necessary to fulfill the hiring purpose and will be deleted shortly thereafter once the role is filled.

We may utilize vendor tools to assist with the AI process. Vendor functions are ‘skill assessments' or 'resume analysis'.

Panopto is dedicated to a fair and equitable hiring process for all candidates.

raw.title: Freelance Data Scraping Engineer (Python)
raw.excerpt: Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Python Data Scraping Engineers to join the Tendem project and drive specialized data scraping workflows within our hybrid AI + human system.
raw.description:
Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Python Data Scraping Engineers to join the Tendem project and drive specialized data scraping workflows within our hybrid AI + human system.

In this role, as an AI Pilot – that’s how we refer to this role at Mindrift – you’ll collaborate with Tendem Agents that handle repetitive tasks, while you provide critical thinking, domain expertise, and quality control to deliver accurate and actionable results.

This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for technical professionals with hands-on experience in web scraping, data extraction and processing.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Python Data Scraping Engineer, you'll handle data scraping tasks requiring technical precision for web extraction and processing, utilizing various tools such as our provided Apify and OpenRouter alongside your own resourceful approaches.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end data extraction workflows across complex websites, ensuring complete coverage, accuracy, and reliable delivery of structured datasets.
  • Leverage internal tools (Apify, OpenRouter) alongside custom workflows to accelerate data collection, validation, and task execution while meeting defined requirements.
  • Ensure reliable extraction from dynamic and interactive web sources, adapting approaches as needed to handle JavaScript-rendered content and changing site behavior.
  • Enforce data quality standards through validation checks, cross-source consistency controls, adherence to formatting specifications, and systematic verification prior to delivery.
  • Scale scraping operations for large datasets using efficient batching or parallelization, monitor failures, and maintain stability against minor site structure changes.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $40 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

How to get started

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects that match your technical skills, on your own schedule. From coding and automation to fine-tuning AI outputs, you’ll play a key role in advancing AI capabilities and real-world applications.

Requirements

  • At least 3 year of relevant experience in data engineering, web scraping, automation, or software development (required).
  • Bachelor's or Master’s Degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related technical fields is a plus.
  • Strong experience in Python web scraping (BeautifulSoup, Selenium or similar), including dynamic content (JS, AJAX, infinite scroll) and APIs via proxies.
  • Proven ability to extract data from complex structures (hierarchies, archived pages, inconsistent HTML).
  • Solid background in data cleaning, normalization, and validation, delivering structured datasets (CSV, JSON, Google Sheets).
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI frameworks to enhance automation and problem-solving.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Self-directed work ethic with ability to troubleshoot independently.
  • A link to GitHub is a plus.
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required).

Benefits

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Gain hands-on experience in a unique hybrid environment where human expertise and AI agents collaborate seamlessly — a distinctive skill set in a rapidly growing field.
  • Participate in performance-based bonus programs that reward high-quality work and consistent delivery.

title: Partner Marketing Manager
description: We are seeking a contract Partner Marketing Manager to develop and execute marketing strategies that drive revenue growth across our authorized partner training portfolio — including programs from vendors such as Microsoft, AWS, and Cisco.

raw.title: Partner Marketing Manager
raw.excerpt: We are seeking a contract Partner Marketing Manager to develop and execute marketing strategies that drive revenue growth across our authorized partner training portfolio — including programs from vendors such as Microsoft, AWS, and Cisco.
raw.description:
We are seeking a contract Partner Marketing Manager to develop and execute marketing strategies that drive revenue growth across our authorized partner training portfolio — including programs from vendors such as Microsoft, AWS, and Cisco. Reporting to the Director of Portfolio & Partner Marketing, this role sits at the intersection of partner relationship management, portfolio marketing, and regional demand generation. You will serve as the primary marketing point of contact for partner- side program managers within these authorized training ecosystems, ensuring that our go-to-market activities are aligned to partner requirements, brand standards, and program guidelines. At the same time, you will work closely with Regional Marketing Leaders and Sales teams to translate partner program investments — including Market Development Funds (MDF) — into pipeline-generating campaigns with measurable closed-won impact.
Key Responsibilities
Partner Relationship Management
  • Serve as the primary marketing point of contact for partner-side program managers within our authorized training partner ecosystems, including vendors such as Microsoft, AWS, and Cisco
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with partner marketing, channel, and program teams to ensure alignment on GTM requirements, promotional guidelines, co-branding standards, and content compliance
  • Stay current on partner program changes, certification roadmap updates, and training requirement shifts — proactively communicating relevant changes to internal stakeholders across marketing and sales
  • Represent us in partner marketing forums, business reviews, and
joint planning sessions, positioning the organization as a preferred and high- performing authorized training partner
  • Identify new co-marketing opportunities within existing partner relationships and advocate for our inclusion in partner-led demand programs, events, and content initiatives
Portfolio Marketing Strategy
  • Develop and maintain partner-aligned marketing plans for each major training portfolio (e.g., Microsoft, AWS, Cisco), translating vendor program priorities and certification roadmaps into audience-relevant messaging and campaign themes
  • Partner closely with the Director of Portfolio & Partner Marketing to ensure partner marketing plans are integrated into the broader portfolio strategy and support overall revenue goals
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing Managers to develop compelling value propositions, messaging frameworks, and content assets for partner-branded training offerings
  • Coordinate with the Content Marketing Manager to ensure partner portfolio content — including landing pages, course descriptions, promotional copy, and enablement materials — accurately reflects current program offerings and partner brand guidelines
  • Ensure messaging consistency and compliance across all partner-facing and partner-co-branded marketing materials, subject to partner review and approval where required
Regional Demand Generation Coordination
  • Work in close coordination with Regional Marketing Leaders across NAM, EMEA, and MEA to develop and localize demand generation programs that drive enrollment in partner-certified training courses
  • Brief regional marketing teams on partner portfolio priorities, available MDF programs, and co-marketing assets — ensuring regional plans reflect both local market needs and partner program requirements
  • Collaborate with Campaign Ops on campaign architecture, tracking, and reporting for partner-specific programs, ensuring consistent measurement and attribution across regions
  • Support the Digital Marketing Manager and regional teams in identifying paid media, webinar, and event opportunities that can be funded through or aligned to partner MDF programs
  • Monitor regional pipeline performance against partner portfolio targets, identifying gaps and working with regional sales and marketing leaders to adjust tactics accordingly
MDF Program Management
  • Own the end-to-end management of Market Development Fund (MDF) programs across all active partner relationships, including fund requests, activity proposals, execution coordination, and claims submission
  • Develop joint marketing plans and MDF proposals in alignment with partner program requirements, our business priorities, and regional sales input — ensuring funds are allocated to highest-impact demand-gen activities
  • Coordinate with Regional Marketing Leaders, Campaign Ops, and Sales to execute MDF-funded programs on time and within partner-defined parameters
  • Track MDF utilization, program performance, and ROI across all partner programs — maintaining accurate records and delivering reporting to both internal leadership and partner stakeholders
  • Proactively identify opportunities to maximize MDF allocations and negotiate expanded program investments based on demonstrated performance and partner relationship strength
Sales & Marketing Alignment
  • Partner with regional Sales leaders and Account Executives to ensure partner portfolio priorities are reflected in account-level outreach, pipeline activity, and customer conversations
  • Develop sales enablement materials specific to partner training portfolios, including talk tracks, competitive positioning, program overviews, and objection handling guides
  • Participate in regular sales and marketing syncs to surface partner program updates, share campaign performance data, and align on pipeline priorities across regions
  • Collaborate with the Customer Marketing Manager to identify re-engagement and upsell opportunities within existing accounts holding partner-aligned training agreements or prepay balances
Ideal Candidate
  • 5+ years of experience in partner marketing, channel marketing, or alliance marketing — preferably within the technology training, SaaS, or enterprise software ecosystem
  • Demonstrated experience managing co-marketing programs and MDF relationships with major technology vendors such as Microsoft, AWS, Cisco, or comparable partners
  • Strong understanding of authorized training partner program structures, certification ecosystems, and vendor GTM requirements
  • Proven ability to build and maintain productive relationships with external partner stakeholders while simultaneously managing internal cross-functional coordination
  • Experience working with regional marketing teams across multiple geographies, with an appreciation for localization nuance and market-specific demand dynamics
  • Solid grasp of demand generation principles, campaign planning, and pipeline measurement — with the ability to connect partner investment to pipeline and revenue outcomes
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple partner programs and regional workstreams simultaneously
  • Strong written communication skills with experience developing co-branded content, program briefs, and executive-level reporting
  • Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Marketo) and comfort working within structured reporting environments
  • Experience in a B2B training, professional development, or certification-focused business is a strong plus

raw.description:
Who we are:

Tinuiti is the largest independent full-funnel marketing agency in the U.S. across the media that matters most, with $4 billion in digital media under management and more than 1,200 employees. Built for marketers who demand growth and accountability, Tinuiti unites media and measurement under one roof to eliminate waste—the biggest growth killer of all—and scale what works. Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti, reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. With expert teams across Commerce, Search, Social, TV & Audio, and more, Tinuiti delivers measurable results with brutal simplicity: Love Growth. Hate Waste.


We support 100% remote work for this role!


We’d love to hear from you if:

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you qualify, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

As the Insights Director you will be responsible for:

Strategic Analytics & Enterprise Measurement

  • Lead the development of holistic, enterprise-level measurement frameworks that move beyond channel-specific metrics to capture total business impact.

  • Design and oversee multi-year learning agendas and sophisticated testing roadmaps (incrementality, geo-testing, etc.) that align with long-term C-suite objectives.

  • Expertly navigate the transition to modern measurement (MMM, unified measurement, clean rooms) and provide guidance on privacy-safe data strategies.

  • CPG Vertical Focus: Leverage deep knowledge of CPG dynamics including retail media networks, household penetration, and market share data to contextualize performance against industry benchmarks.

Executive Client Partnership

  • Build and maintain deep-seated relationships with senior client stakeholders (VP and C-level). You are the first person they call for a POV on industry shifts or business challenges.

  • Identify opportunities where advanced analytics can solve business problems, effectively scoping and selling in high-value projects that drive incremental agency revenue.

  • Act as the guardian of the analytical relationship, proactively identifying potential friction points and ensuring our insights are indispensable to the client's success.

Internal Stakeholder Leadership

  • Serve as the strategic connection between Planning, Investment, and Strategy teams, ensuring that data-driven insights are woven into the fabric of every media plan.

  • While not necessarily a direct people manager of engineers, you will provide "dotted-line" mentorship to junior analysts, elevating their ability to tell stories with data and think more strategically.

  • Partner with BI and Data Engineering leads to ensure the data infrastructure supports the strategic vision without needing to manage the underlying code or ETL processes yourself.

Thought Leadership & Communication

  • Distill highly complex statistical concepts into compelling narratives for non-technical audiences. You don't just present data; you present a business case.

  • Develop and publish internal and external POVs on emerging trends (e.g., the demise of third-party cookies, AI in marketing, or the evolution of retail media).

People Management

  • You will have several direct reports at the Manager or Sr. Analyst level and will be responsible for their career development. This includes defining and tracking progress against long term goals, delegating responsibilities, and proving valuable feedback.

Professional Qualifications

  • Experience: 10+ years of experience in marketing analytics, business intelligence, or management consulting, with at least 4 years in a high-level client-facing leadership role.

  • Strategy Over Execution: Proven track record of designing measurement frameworks for global brands, with a focus on long-term brand health and enterprise-level ROI.

  • Enterprise Measurement Literacy: Deep familiarity with the application and interpretation of Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) and Incrementality testing. You understand the limitations and strengths of these tools better than the tools themselves.

  • Vertical Expertise: Prior experience in the CPG/Retail sector is highly preferred, including familiarity with IRI/Nielsen data and the nuances of the path-to-purchase in a fragmented retail landscape.

  • Communication: Exceptional presentation skills; ability to command a room and influence senior decision-makers through clarity, confidence, and commercial acumen.

  • Technical Literacy (Strategic Level): While you are not expected to build dashboards or write SQL daily, you must have the technical fluency to collaborate with engineers and data scientists.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Marketing, Business) or equivalent experience; MBA or Master’s in a related field is a plus.

The hiring salary range for this role is $130,000 - $150,000. We also offer an incentive pay program (RevShare) comprising a monthly variable revenue payment opportunity and a discretionary annual performance bonus.

Hiring salaries are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, parity with other team members, and alignment with market data. We will provide more information on our benefits, incentive pay, and equity upon request. Disclosure as required by the Colorado Equal Pay for > Equal Work Act, C.R.S. § 8-5-101 et seq.

FLSA Classification: Exempt

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.


Benefits:


Unlimited PTO: At Tinuiti, we believe you deserve time to rest, recharge, and enjoy life unplugged. When you prioritize time for yourself, you're able to bring your best self to work. That’s why we offer unlimited paid time off, a fully remote environment, and flexibility to take the time you need, when you need it. On top of that, we provide 20 paid holidays, including multiple long weekends, to ensure you have dedicated time to step away and disconnect. We're proud to offer above-industry standard work-life balance, consistently rated as one of the most loved benefits by Tinuitians year after year.

Healthcare: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life & Disability, Flex Spending Accounts

Retirement: Match up to 4% of your contributions at 100%

Perks and Wellness: Fringe, Forma, Unlimited Telemedicine and Teletherapy available at no cost, Thankful giving, Equity

Parental Leave: Birthing parents receive 16 weeks of leave with 100% pay (partners 12 weeks) after the birth or adoption of a child.

Learning and Development: On-demand learning, mentorship program, leadership and management development programs and resources


Disclaimer: This description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this position. The actual duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may vary based on assignment or group. Tinuiti is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected status.

Solutions Engineer

Location: Singapore

About the Role

Pixalate is the market-leading fraud protection, privacy, and compliance analytics platform for Connected TV (CTV) and Mobile Advertising. We work 24/7 to guard our clients' reputations and grow their media value.

As a Forward Deployment Engineer at Pixalate, you'll solve the "Last Mile" problem, bridging the gap between Pixalate's platform and each customer's unique business environment. You are the technical anchor of our sales team, architecting the specific configurations that allow clients to unlock the full value of our fraud detection and digital trust solutions.

Our Forward Deployment Engineers operate as a team of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). You'll be assigned a specific Product Line (e.g., Data Feeds, Analytics, or Compliance) and deployed to sales calls when clients have needs in your domain. You act as the critical feedback loop between the market and Core Engineering while driving trial conversions and revenue for your product.

What You’ll Do

  • Sales Technical Partnership
    • Serve as the technical authority for your assigned product on every sales call
    • Validate technical feasibility, answer architectural questions, and remove blockers
    • Ensure clients feel technically confident moving forward with deals
  • Micro-Product Management
    • Own a specific product line as its deep SME in the field
    • Manage the technical roadmap for your product within each sales opportunity
    • Collaborate with other FDEs when clients need multiple product integrations
  • Pre-Launch Customer Validation
    • Serve as the gatekeeper for product relevance within your assigned product line
    • Secure direct customer feedback before any feature launches
    • Validate solutions with live clients to ensure they solve actual business problems
  • End-to-End Trial Ownership
    • Own technical accountability for your product line within each account
    • Work as part of the FDE Integration Team to ensure complete client integration
    • Remain engaged until your product is live, stable, and proving value
  • Last Mile Solution Architecture
    • Translate client's unstructured problems into clean Pixalate configurations
    • Map specific data fields and business logic to our platform
    • Ensure clients are actually protected in their specific environment
  • Use Case Definition & Delivery
    • Author a specific Use Case Document for every engagement
    • Define exactly how the client applies Pixalate to their business (e.g., "Filtering IVT on Mobile App Traffic")
    • Establish the official "Definition of Done" for each trial
  • Churn Risk Mitigation
    • Serve as the first line of defense against churn
    • Manually verify that data flowing into client dashboards matches the promised Use Case
    • Ensure clients experience their "Aha!" moment—seeing specific dollar savings or risk avoided—before contract signing
  • Post-Integration Handoff
    • Facilitate detailed technical transfer to Customer Success after contract signing
    • Document custom configurations and Use Cases for ongoing support

Required Qualifications

  • Technical Foundation
    • Strong understanding of data integration, APIs, and system architecture
    • Experience translating business requirements into technical configurations
    • Familiarity with ad tech, fraud detection, or digital analytics platforms required
  • Communication & Collaboration
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills for client-facing interactions
    • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
    • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Engineering, and Product teams
  • Problem-Solving Skills
    • Proven ability to diagnose and resolve complex integration challenges
    • Track record of creative problem-solving in ambiguous technical environments
    • Strong documentation and process definition skills
  • Preferred Qualifications
    • At least 3 - 4 years of experience in AdTech, programmatic advertising, or digital fraud detection.
    • Background in solutions engineering, technical consulting, or pre-sales engineering.
    • Familiarity with CTV, mobile app analytics, or data feed integrations.
    • Experience with trial management and customer success metrics.
    • Understanding of IVT (Invalid Traffic) or ad fraud concepts.

We're particularly interested in candidates who thrive at the intersection of technical depth and customer empathy. Show us how you've turned complex technical challenges into measurable customer wins.

Other Requirements
  • Time Zone Flexibility: You must be willing to accommodate early morning or late evening calls to align with global engineering teams across US, EMEA, and APAC time zones.
  • High-Volume Multitasking
  • AdTech Knowledge: A foundational understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem (DSP, SSP, Ad Server) is highly preferred.
Benefits
We focus on doing things differently and challenge each other to be the best we can be.
  • A Competitive Compensation Package
  • Monthly Internet Reimbursement
  • Casual, Remote Work Environment
  • Flexible Hours
  • Opportunity for Advancement and Professional Development
  • Fun Annual Team Events
  • Being part of a high-performing global team that wants to win and have fun doing it

About Pixalate
Pixalate offers the market-leading fraud protection, privacy, and compliance analytics platform for Connected TV (CTV), Mobile Apps, and Websites.

Our platform has been used to unearth multiple high-profile criminal and illegal surveillance cases, including:

  • Gizmodo: An iCloud Feature Is Enabling a $65 Million Scam, New Research Says
  • Adweek: A 7-Figure Ad Fraud Scheme Running on Roku Underlines Murkiness of CTV
  • Washington Post: Your kids’ apps are spying on them
  • Pro Publica: Porn, Piracy, Fraud: What Lurks Inside Google’s Black Box Ad Empire
  • ABC7 News: The State of Children's Privacy Online
  • NBC News: How many apps are tracking your children

Our team of lawyers, data scientists, engineers, economists, and researchers spans globally with presence in California, New York, Washington DC, London and Singapore.

raw.description:
Job Description: PCI Internal Security Assessor (ISA)

Department: Enterprise Security & Technology Risk Management Location: Regionwide

Reports To: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Overview

The PCI Internal Security Assessor (ISA) is responsible for ensuring that our client from banking industry complies with the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS). The ISA will assess, monitor, and enforce the security measures necessary to protect cardholder data and maintain PCI compliance across all systems and processes. This role works closely with internal stakeholders and external parties to maintain a secure environment, mitigate risks, and improve overall security posture.

Key Responsibilities:

  • PCI DSS Compliance Management:
    • Conduct regular internal assessments and audits to ensure the organization's compliance with PCI DSS.

Develop and implement PCI compliance policies, procedures, and controls.

  • Serve as the internal point of contact for PCI DSS-related matters and ensure all applicable security controls are in place.
  • Collaborate with the external Qualified Security Assessor (QSA) to facilitate annual PCI DSS certification audits.

Documentation and Reporting:

  • Prepare and maintain comprehensive documentation, including policies, procedures, and reports required for PCI DSS compliance.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of assessment findings, corrective actions, and compliance status.
  • Manage the submission of the Self-Assessment Questionnaires (SAQs) and Attestation of Compliance documents (AOCs) as needed.

Qualifications:

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field (or

equivalent work experience).

  • Experience:
    • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in information security, PCI compliance, or a related field.
    • Previous experience as an ISA, QSA, or a similar role is highly desirable.
  • Certifications:
    • Certified PCI Internal Security Assessor (ISA) or Certified PCI Professional (PCIP) certifications preferred.

Additional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, or CEH are a plus.

  • Skills and Competencies:
    • Deep understanding of PCI DSS requirements and data security best practices.
    • Familiarity with security frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls) and security technologies (firewalls, IDS/IPS, encryption, etc.).
    • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.
    • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross- functionally.
    • Proficiency in using security assessment tools and techniques (e.g., vulnerability scanners, SIEM).

Other Requirements:

Ability to work independently and handle sensitive information confidentially.

  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.
  • Occasional travel may be required for audits or compliance reviews.
  • Risk Assessment and Mitigation:
    • Identify and assess potential risks to cardholder data environments and provide recommendations for risk mitigation.
    • Implement and enforce necessary security controls to address gaps identified during assessments.
    • Ensure vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, and security reviews are conducted to identify weaknesses and ensure continuous compliance.
  • Training and Awareness:
    • Conduct internal PCI DSS training for staff to ensure a deep understanding of the importance of compliance and security measures.
    • Provide ongoing guidance and support to departments regarding security best practices related to PCI DSS.
  • Collaboration and Communication:
    • Work closely with projects, Enterprise Security, Technology, and other relevant departments to align PCI DSS compliance with overall security policies and practices.
    • Proactively identify and/or promptly escalate risks and issues affecting PCI compliance status.
    • Stay updated on changes in PCI DSS requirements and industry best practices to ensure our client from banking industry remains compliant.
    • Present PCI DSS compliance status reports to senior management and external stakeholders.
    • Act as a liaison where necessary between our client from banking industry and external vendors or service providers involved in processing or storing cardholder data.

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Aeronautics Systems Global Supply Chain (GSC), Goods Movement & Logistics (GM&L) has an opening for a ManagerProject Management 2 to ​join our team of qualified, diverse individuals.

This position can be hybrid or remote, or can be based onsite in Melbourne, FL or Palmdale, CA. Occasional travel to varied NGAS sites may be required to support business needs.

This position reports to the GSC Sector Logistics Director for the Aeronautics Systems Sector and will be responsible for Project Management initiatives in support of all programs and sites across the sector, such as oversight of planning and managing the operational aspects of ongoing projects throughout the sector. They will be responsible for establishing reviews rhythms for project status and budgets; managing schedules, productivity and reporting preparation. As the functional manager of a small team, they are responsible for assessing project issues and developing resolutions to meet productivity, quality, and customer and program-focused goals and objectives, developing mechanisms for monitoring project progress through closure and for intervention and problem solving with peer leaders and matrixed reporting responsibilities. The role will be responsible for development, sustainment and evolution of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) across the different logistics disciplines (Transportation, Traffic & Packaging, Handling, Storage & Transportability (PHS&T)). Selected candidate will responsible for activities and knowledge within multiple disciplines across the Supply Chain organization, exhibiting end-to-end supply chain competence.

Our Leaders at Northrop Grumman live our values daily and encourage our teams to do the same. We do the right thing: upholding the highest ethical standards and facilitating a safe and respectful environment that attracts, retains, and inspires a diverse and engaged team. We do what we promise: holding yourself and others accountable to meet predictable and balanced results. We commit to shared success:operating as OneNG and removing barriers for our teams. Finally, we pioneer: setting a vision that shapes the future and inspires others.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Accountable for project management oversight across the sector, acting as the escalation path to address issues in program execution related to the execution
  • Lead a team of individual contributors who are responsible for supporting all sector sites, programs and product line objectives
  • Managing matrixed/dotted line relationships with teams of peer leaders and individual contributors, based on functional disciplines
  • Develop and Drive strategy for Logistics operations that align with sector goals, ensuring supply chain processes are optimized to support business growth, operational excellence and customer satisfaction
  • Collaborate closely across cross-functional teams, overseeing digital transformation throughout the Logistics disciplines (Transportation, Traffic & PHS&T)
  • Serve as a key liaison with internal customers and executive leadership, communicating strategic plans and operational performance effectively and transparently
  • Cultivate a high performing engaged culture by modeling respect, ownership and joint accountability, while fostering empowerment and promoting straight talk across all levels of the organization
  • Provide mentorship, coaching, and succession planning to ensure leadership readiness across the organization, training and guiding employees to ensure alignment with Northrop Grumman Leadership Values and Behaviors

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree with 5 years of experience OR Master’s Degree with 3 years of experience OR High School Diploma/Equivalent with 9 years of experience; Experience in any of the following: Supply Chain Management, Logistics Management, Project Management, Business Management, Engineering, Operations or Manufacturing.
  • Minimum of 2 years experience leading a team, process, and/or projects
  • Active U.S. Government Secret level clearance is required to apply and to start the role, with the ability to obtain and maintain Special Program Access within a reasonable amount of time as determined by the Company to meet its business needs

​

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Supply Chain, Operations or Manufacturing experience
  • Experience preparing and presenting executive-level presentations
  • Experience leading teams in a virtual or geographically dispersed environment
  • Experience as an accomplished problem-solver and change-agent whose unique mix of technical and business expertise lends itself to developing innovative Supply Chain strategies

Description:

SPS Commerce is a leading provider of cloud-based supply chain management solutions, serving a global network of retail trading partners. We foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment where innovation and continuous improvement are highly valued. Join SPS Commerce and be part of a dynamic team that's transforming the global retail supply chain!

Position Summary:

We are seeking an Account Executive to join our Sales Team. In this quota-carrying and fast-paced role, the Account Executive will continuously seek net new business derived from prospecting, territory management, and periodically going onsite. This position will pull in resources from the sales engineering team and work to transition business to our implementation team. Once a new customer is onboard, this account will remain as part of the territory for possible upsell or cross sell. The Account Executive will grow business with a constant mix of new and expanding clients with a strong emphasis on net new customer acquisition.

It is a 100% Direct Sales role.

Essential Responsibilities / Duties:

-Drive a prescriptive sales process and manage a defined sales territory (e.g., identify, develop, and close new business opportunities)
